_doc: D6. State: { finding: { summary }, fix: { diff } }. 'true' on scope_creep / weakens_test means escalate.

addresses.instructions: Does `fix.diff` directly correct the problem described in `finding.summary`?

scope_creep.instructions: Does `fix.diff` change behavior unrelated to `finding.summary` (other features, refactors, formatting of untouched code, new dependencies)?

criteria.true: It changes something the finding did not ask for
criteria.false: Every changed line serves the fix or its test

weakens_test.instructions: Does `fix.diff` delete, skip, loosen, or rewrite an existing test assertion so that it passes more easily?
